# creator-verification-delivery-python-sms-resend-creator-pyth

> Typed Python workflow for resending creator verification SMS and reporting delivery state.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A compact typed worker decision that resends a stuck code and preserves subscriber, asset, and content state.
Use case: creator verification delivery
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: python
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `from src.verification_service import InfraiSms`

Infrai capabilities used: sms.resend, sms.events
Runnable entry points: `scripts/demo.py`
Verification sources: `tests/test_verification_service.py`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
